## p

2. the 16th letter of the Roman alphabet

## pa

*n.* 1. **爸, 爹, 爹爹, 爸爸** — an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk

5. an electronic amplification system used as a communication system in public areas

## pace

**發音：** /peɪs/
*n.* 1. **步速, 移動速度** — the rate of moving (especially walking or running)
2. **以步測量, 步幅, 步度, 踏級** — the distance covered by a step
*“he stepped off ten paces from the old tree and began to dig”*
3. **速率, 速度** — the relative speed of progress or change
*“he lived at a fast pace”*
*“he works at a great rate”*
4. **速度, 節奏 /節奏** — Speed or velocity in general.
5. **節奏** — the rate of some repeating event
6. **碼** — a unit of length equal to 3 feet; defined as 91.44 centimeters; originally taken to be the average length of a stride
*v.* 1. **慢慢地走** — go at a pace
*“The horse paced”*
2. walk with slow or fast paces
*“He paced up and down the hall”*
3. measure (distances) by pacing
*“step off ten yards”*
4. regulate or set the pace of
*“Pace your efforts”*

<a id="entry-p-000013"></a>
## pace stick

*n.* 1. **步規 /步規** — A stick or implement used to measure paces.

<a id="entry-p-000014"></a>
## pacemaker

**發音：** /ˈpeɪsˌmeɪkəɹ/
*n.* 1. **竇房結 /竇房結** — Specialized cells which stimulate the heart to beat.
2. *(broadly)* **起搏器** — A medical implement that is used to stimulate a heart to beat by simulating the action of the natural pacemaker.
3. *(uncommon)* **帶步人 /帶步人, 配速員 /配速員** — One who sets the pace in a race, to guide the others.
4. **溜蹄的馬** — a horse used to set the pace in racing
5. a leading instance in its field
*“the new policy will be a pacesetter in community relations”*
6. a specialized bit of heart tissue that controls the heartbeat

## pack

**發音：** /pæk/
*v.* 1. **裝** — arrange in a container
*“pack the books into the boxes”*
2. **使擠滿, 擠** — fill to capacity
*“This singer always packs the concert halls”*
*“The murder trial packed the court house”*
3. **包裝, 捆紮** — set up a committee or legislative body with one's own supporters so as to influence the outcome
*“pack a jury”*
4. *(physical, transitive)* **包, 包裝 /包裝** — To make a pack of; to arrange closely and securely in a pack; hence, to place and arrange compactly as in a pack
5. **拿起, 攜帶, 附有, 拿, 持有** — have with oneself; have on one's person
*“She always takes an umbrella”*
*“I always carry money”*
6. **塞滿, 填滿, 擠向, 蜂擁進入, 擠入** — press tightly together or cram
*“The crowd packed the auditorium”*
*n.* 1. **大批, 大量, 許多** — a large indefinite number
*“a battalion of ants”*
*“a multitude of TV antennas”*
2. **包, 捆** — A bundle made up and prepared to be carried; especially, a bundle to be carried on the back, but also a load for an animal, a bale.
3. **副** — A full set of playing cards
4. **一幫人, 小集團** — an exclusive circle of people with a common purpose
5. **一群狩獵的動物** — a group of hunting animals
6. *(collective)* **群, 一群** — A group of hounds or dogs, hunting or living together.

*v.* 1. *(transitive)* **恐慌** — To cause (someone) to feel panic (“overwhelming fear or fright”); also, to frighten (someone) into acting hastily.

## paradigm

**發音：** /ˈpæɹ.ə.daɪm/
*n.* 1. **詞形變化** — systematic arrangement of all the inflected forms of a word
2. **範式 /範式, 範例 /範例** — A pattern, a way of doing something; especially a pattern of thought, a system of beliefs, a conceptual framework.
3. **範例 /範例, 模範 /模範, 典範 /典範** — An example serving as the model for such a pattern; an exceptionally good or prototypical example of a pattern or group.
4. **詞形變化表 /詞形變化表** — A set of all forms which contain a common element, especially the set of all inflectional forms of a word or a particular grammatical category.
5. a standard or typical example
*“he is the prototype of good breeding”*
*“he provided America with an image of the good father”*
6. the class of all items that can be substituted into the same position (or slot) in a grammatical sentence (are in paradigmatic relation with one another)

<a id="entry-p-000580"></a>
## paradigm shift

*n.* 1. **典範轉移 /典範轉移, 範式轉移 /範式轉移** — A radical change in thinking from an accepted point of view to a new one, necessitated when new scientific discoveries produce anomalies in the current paradigm.
2. *(broadly)* **巨變 /鉅變** — Any radical change, especially in politics or technology.

<a id="entry-p-000581"></a>
## paradigmatic

2. **例證+的, 範例+的, 範式+的** — of or relating to a typical example
*“paradigmatic learning”*
3. **縱聚合+的, 詞形變化+的** — related as members of a substitution class

## parity

**發音：** /ˈpæɹɪti/
*n.* 1. **經產** — (obstetrics) the number of liveborn children a woman has delivered
*“the parity of the mother must be considered”*
*“a bipara is a woman who has given birth to two children”*
2. **奇偶性** — (mathematics) a relation between a pair of integers: if both integers are odd or both are even they have the same parity; if one is odd and the other is even they have different parity
*“parity is often used to check the integrity of transmitted data”*
3. **校驗位** — (computer science) a bit that is used in an error detection procedure in which a 0 or 1 is added to each group of bits so that it will have either an odd number of 1's or an even number of 1's; e.g., if the parity is odd then any group of bits that arrives with an even number of 1's must contain an error
4. *(countable)* **宇稱 /宇稱** — Symmetry of interactions under spatial inversion.
5. **胎次** — The number of times a sow has farrowed.
6. (physics) parity is conserved in a universe in which the laws of physics are the same in a right-handed system of coordinates as in a left-handed system

<a id="entry-p-000942"></a>
## pass

**發音：** /pɑːs/
*v.* 1. **過, 經過, 渡過, 穿過** — go across or through
*“We passed the point where the police car had parked”*
*“A terrible thought went through his mind”*
2. **經過, 走過, 路過** — move past
*“A black limousine passed by when she looked out the window”*
*“He passed his professor in the hall”*
3. **使依法成, 制定法律, 用立法規定, 立法** — make laws, bills, etc. or bring into effect by legislation
*“They passed the amendment”*
*“We cannot legislate how people spend their free time”*
4. **消逝, 過去, 逝去, 流逝, 過** — pass by
*“three years elapsed”*
5. **遞給, 交給, 給, 傳遞** — place into the hands or custody of
*“hand me the spoon, please”*
*“Turn the files over to me, please”*
6. **延伸, 達到** — stretch out over a distance, space, time, or scope; run or extend between two points or beyond a certain point
*“Service runs all the way to Cranbury”*
*“His knowledge doesn't go very far”*
*n.* 1. **通行證** — a document indicating permission to do something without restrictions
*“the media representatives had special passes”*
2. **通過** — success in satisfying a test or requirement
*“his future depended on his passing that test”*
*“he got a pass in introductory chemistry”*
3. **窘境, 困境** — a bad or difficult situation or state of affairs
4. **試圖, 嘗試** — a usually brief attempt
*“he took a crack at it”*
*“I gave it a whirl”*
5. (baseball) an advance to first base by a batter who receives four balls
*“he worked the pitcher for a base on balls”*
6. (military) a written leave of absence
*“he had a pass for three days”*
*adj.* 1. of advancing the ball by throwing it
*“a team with a good passing attack”*
*“a pass play”*

<a id="entry-p-000943"></a>
## pass around

*v.* 1. **傳播, 傳閱, 散佈** — cause be distributed
*“This letter is being circulated among the faculty”*
2. **使廣為人知, 廣為傳播, 推廣, 散播, 傳** — cause to become widely known
*“spread information”*

*“She passed the glass off as diamonds”*

*“The meeting took place off without an incidence”*

<a id="entry-p-001763"></a>
## perfective aspect

*n.* 1. *(uncountable)* **完成體 /完成體** — A feature of the verb which denotes viewing the event the verb describes as a completed whole, rather than from within the event as it unfolds. For example, "she sat down" as opposed to "she was sitting down". Since the focus is on the completion of what is expressed by the verb, this aspect is generally associated with the past and future tenses. This term is often used interchangeably with aorist aspect. This is not to be confused with the perfect tense.
2. **動詞完成體, 完成體** — the aspect of a verb that expresses a completed action

<a id="entry-p-001764"></a>
## perfective tense

## phase

**發音：** /feɪz/
*n.* 1. **階段, 時期** — any distinct time period in a sequence of events
*“we are in a transitional stage in which many former ideas must be revised or rejected”*
2. **狀態** — (physical chemistry) a distinct state of matter in a system; matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary
*“the reaction occurs in the liquid phase of the system”*
3. **相角** — a particular point in the time of a cycle; measured from some arbitrary zero and expressed as an angle
4. **階段 /階段** — A distinguishable part of a sequence or cycle occurring over time.
5. (astronomy) the particular appearance of a body's state of illumination (especially one of the recurring shapes of the part of Earth's moon that is illuminated by the sun)
*“the full phase of the moon”*
*v.* 1. **使同步, 使定期, 使定相, 使相位同步, 使調整相位** — adjust so as to be in a synchronized condition
*“he phased the intake with the output of the machine”*
2. arrange in phases or stages
*“phase a withdrawal”*

<a id="entry-p-002259"></a>
## phase angle

*n.* 1. **相角** — a particular point in the time of a cycle; measured from some arbitrary zero and expressed as an angle

<a id="entry-p-002260"></a>

<a id="entry-p-002263"></a>

*“a multidimensional phase space”*

<a id="entry-p-002264"></a>

## phone

**發音：** /ˈfəʊ̯n/
*n.* 1. **電話, 電話機** — electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
*“I talked to him on the telephone”*
2. **語音 /語音** — A speech segment that possesses distinct physical or perceptual properties, considered as a physical event without regard to its place in the phonology of a language.
3. **受話器, 耳機** — electro-acoustic transducer for converting electric signals into sounds; it is held over or inserted into the ear
*“it was not the typing but the earphones that she disliked”*
4. (phonetics) an individual sound unit of speech without concern as to whether or not it is a phoneme of some language
*v.* 1. **打電話, 電話, 呼叫, 召集** — get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
*“I tried to call you all night”*
*“Take two aspirin and call me in the morning”*
2. *(ambitransitive)* **打電話 /打電話** — To call (someone) using a telephone.

<a id="entry-p-002450"></a>
## phone call

*n.* 1. **電話聯繫, 電話聯絡, 電話** — a telephone connection
*“she reported several anonymous calls”*
*“he placed a phone call to London”*

<a id="entry-p-002451"></a>
## phone card

*n.* 1. **電話卡, 電話磁卡** — a card that is used instead of cash to make telephone calls

<a id="entry-p-002452"></a>
## phone case

*n.* 1. **手機殼 /手機殼** — A protective covering designed to fit around a mobile phone.

<a id="entry-p-002453"></a>
## phone in

*v.* 1. *(ambitransitive)* **致電 /致電** — To deliver a message by telephone when etiquette demands the effort and respect conveyed by communication in person.
2. *(intransitive)* **叩應 /叩應, 打電話參與 /打電話參與** — To make a telephone call to a broadcasting station, especially to participate in a program being aired.
3. *(ambitransitive, figuratively, idiomatic)* **敷衍了事, 應付差事 /應付差事** — To fulfill a responsibility with a minimum effort rather than the appropriate level of effort.
4. *(transitive)* **畏縮不前 /畏縮不前, 畏首畏尾** — To make an unseemly, timid performance; to be restrained and timid when bold action is called for.

## phoneme

**發音：** /ˈfəʊ.niːm/
*n.* 1. **音素, 音位** — An indivisible unit of sound in a given language. A phoneme is an abstraction of the physical speech sounds (phones) and may encompass several different phones.
2. (linguistics) one of a small set of speech sounds that are distinguished by the speakers of a particular language

<a id="entry-p-002460"></a>

*adv.* 1. by phonemics
*“phonemically transcribed”*

## phonetic

**發音：** /fəˈnɛt.ɪk/
*adj.* 1. **語音+的** — of or relating to speech sounds
*“phonetic transcription”*
2. **語音學+的** — of or relating to the scientific study of speech sounds
*“phonetic analysis”*
*n.* 1. **聲旁 /聲旁, 聲符 /聲符, 形聲偏旁 /形聲偏旁** — In such writing systems as the Chinese writing system, the portion of a phono-semantic character that provides an indication of its pronunciation; contrasted with semantic (which is usually the radical).

<a id="entry-p-002462"></a>
## phonetic symbol

*n.* 1. **音標 /音標** — A written symbol used systematically for denoting a phoneme or any other phonetic quality in utterance.

<a id="entry-p-002463"></a>
## phonetics

**發音：** /fəˈnɛt.ɪks/

2. the branch of acoustics concerned with speech processes including its production and perception and acoustic analysis

<a id="entry-p-002464"></a>

3. **語音+的** — of or relating to speech sounds

## physical

**發音：** /ˈfɪz.ɪ.kəl/

*“physical suffering”*

*“physical laws”*
3. **物理的, 身體的 /身體的** — Having to do with the body as opposed to the mind; corporeal, bodily.
4. **筋力的** — Involving bodily force or contact; vigorous, aggressive.
5. having substance or material existence; perceptible to the senses
*“a physical manifestation”*
*“surrounded by tangible objects”*

*“a reflex response to physical stimuli”*

## pick

**發音：** /pɪk/
*v.* 1. **精選** — select carefully from a group
*“She finally picked her successor”*

2. **挑揀, 挑選, 採, 摘, 選擇** — look for and gather
*“pick mushrooms”*
*“pick flowers”*
3. **怪, 挑剔, 責怪, 責備, 譴責** — harass with constant criticism
*“Don't always pick on your little brother”*
4. **摘** — To harvest a fruit or vegetable for consumption by removing it from the plant to which it is attached; to harvest an entire plant by removing it from the ground.
5. **摘, 挖** — pilfer or rob
*“pick pockets”*
6. **結算** — pay for something
*“pick up the tab”*
*“pick up the burden of high-interest mortgages”*
*n.* 1. **鶴嘴鋤 /鶴嘴鋤** — A tool used for digging; a pickaxe.
2. **收割量, 採集量** — the quantity of a crop that is harvested
*“he sent the first picking of berries to the market”*
*“it was the biggest peach pick in years”*
3. **萬能鑰匙** — A tool for unlocking a lock without the original key; a lock pick, picklock.
4. the person or thing chosen or selected
*“he was my pick for mayor”*
5. the best people or things in a group
*“the cream of England's young men were killed in the Great War”*
6. the yarn woven across the warp yarn in weaving

## place

*v.* 1. **安置, 擱, 擺, 放, 置** — put into a certain place or abstract location
*“Put your things here”*
*“Set the tray down”*
2. **任命** — place somebody in a particular situation or location
*“he was placed on probation”*
3. **排名, 評價, 評估** — assign a rank or rating to
*“how would you rank these students?”*
*“The restaurant is rated highly in the food guide”*
4. **任命, 安置** — assign to (a job or a home)
5. **定位** — identify the location or place of
*“We localized the source of the infection”*
6. **買進, 投資** — make an investment
*“Put money into bonds”*
*n.* 1. **地方, 地點** — a point located with respect to surface features of some region
*“this is a nice place for a picnic”*
*“a bright spot on a planet”*
2. **特定場合** — a particular situation
*“If you were in my place what would you do?”*
3. **身份, 地位, 職位** — proper or designated social situation
*“he overstepped his place”*
*“the responsibilities of a man in his station”*
4. **座位** — a space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)
*“he booked their seats in advance”*
*“he sat in someone else's place”*
5. **合適的位置, 適當的場合** — proper or appropriate position or location
*“a woman's place is no longer in the kitchen”*
6. any area set aside for a particular purpose
*“who owns this place?”*
*“the president was concerned about the property across from the White House”*

<a id="entry-p-003308"></a>
## placebo effect

*n.* 1. *(especially)* **安慰劑效應 /安慰劑效應** — A phenomenon where a person's health improves after receiving a treatment that has no direct therapeutic mechanism.
2. any effect that seems to be a consequence of administering a placebo; the change is usually beneficial and is assumed result from the person's faith in the treatment or preconceptions about what the experimental drug was supposed to do; pharmacologists were the first to talk about placebo effects but now the idea has been generalized to many situations having nothing to do with drugs

*“The band played all night long”*

*“The kids were playing outside all day”*
*“I used to play with trucks as a little girl”*

*“The students all recreate alike”*
*n.* 1. **劇本, 戲劇** — a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage

*“they made a futile play for power”*
*“he made a bid to gain attention”*
3. **容易乾的事情, 玩, 遊戲** — activity by children that is guided more by imagination than by fixed rules

4. **比賽回合** — (in games or plays or other performances) the time during which play proceeds
*“rain stopped play in the 4th inning”*
5. **完全自由** — the removal of constraints
*“he gave free rein to his impulses”*
*“they gave full play to the artist's talent”*
6. **賭博, 賭勝負, 投機** — the act of playing for stakes in the hope of winning (including the payment of a price for a chance to win a prize)

*“there was heavy play at the blackjack table”*

## pledge

**發音：** /plɛd͡ʒ/
*v.* 1. **保證, 發誓, 擔保** — promise solemnly and formally

3. **發誓 /發誓, 保證 /保證** — To make a solemn promise (to do something).

*“I pledged $10 a month to my favorite radio station”*

*“Let's drink to the New Year”*

*“I pledge my honor”*
*n.* 1. **典押, 抵押** — a deposit of personal property as security for a debt

3. **保證** — a binding commitment to do or give or refrain from something
*“an assurance of help when needed”*
*“signed a pledge never to reveal the secret”*
4. someone accepted for membership but not yet fully admitted to the group
5. a drink in honor of or to the health of a person or event

*“The candles are tapered”*
6. direct into a position for use
*“point a gun”*
*“He charged his weapon at me”*
*n.* 1. **細節** — an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole
*“several of the details are similar”*
*“a point of information”*

*“a remarkable degree of frankness”*

3. **關頭, 時間點** — an instant of time
*“at that point I had to leave”*

*“the cannibal's teeth were filed to sharp points”*

*“he scored 20 points in the first half”*

**發音：** /pəʊk/
*v.* 1. **干涉, 探出, 探聽, 刺探, 干預** — search or inquire in a meddlesome way
*“This guy is always nosing around the office”*
2. **戳, 捅, 刺** — To prod or jab with an object such as a finger or a stick.
3. poke or thrust abruptly
*“he jabbed his finger into her ribs”*
4. stir by poking
*“poke the embers in the fireplace”*
5. hit hard with the hand, fist, or some heavy instrument
*“the salesman pounded the door knocker”*
*“a bible-thumping Southern Baptist”*
6. make a hole by poking
*n.* 1. **以拳重擊, 打, 拳, 拳打** — (boxing) a blow with the fist
*“I gave him a clout on his nose”*
2. tall coarse perennial American herb having small white flowers followed by blackish-red berries on long drooping racemes; young fleshy stems are edible; berries and root are poisonous
3. someone who takes more time than necessary; someone who lags behind
4. a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases
5. a sharp hand gesture (resembling a blow)
*“he warned me with a jab with his finger”*
*“he made a thrusting motion with his fist”*

*“the mail handles billions of items every day”*
*“he works for the United States mail service”*

*“he set a row of posts in the ground and strung barbwire between them”*
*v.* 1. **張帖** — publicize with, or as if with, a poster

*“send me your latest results”*

6. affix in a public place or for public notice
*“post a warning”*

## potential

**發音：** /pəˈtɛnʃəl/
*n.* 1. **潛力, 潛能, 潛質, 可能性** — the inherent capacity for coming into being
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **潛力 /潛力, 潛力, 潛質 /潛質, 潛質** — A currently unrealized ability (with the most common adposition being to).
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **勢能 /勢能** — The gravitational potential: the radial (irrotational, static) component of a gravitational field, also known as the Newtonian potential or the gravitoelectric field.
4. *(countable, uncountable)* **電勢 /電勢, 電位 /電位** — The work (energy) required to move a reference particle from a reference location to a specified location in the presence of a force field, for example to bring a unit positive electric charge from an infinite distance to a specified point against an electric field.
5. the difference in electrical charge between two points in a circuit expressed in volts
*adj.* 1. **可能+的, 有潛力+的, 潛在+的** — existing in possibility
*“a potential problem”*
*“possible uses of nuclear power”*

3. expected to become or be; in prospect

*“`Socrates is a man' predicates manhood of Socrates”*

## preposition

*n.* 1. *(broadly)* **介詞 /介詞, 前置詞 /前置詞** — An adposition.
2. a function word that combines with a noun or pronoun or noun phrase to form a prepositional phrase that can have an adverbial or adjectival relation to some other word
3. (linguistics) the placing of one linguistic element before another (as placing a modifier before the word it modifies in a sentence or placing an affix before the base to which it is attached)

## prepositional case

<a id="entry-p-005171"></a>
## prepositional phrase

## present

**發音：** /ˈpɹɛz.ənt/
*adj.* 1. **現在+的** — temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration
*“the present leader”*
*“articles for present use”*
2. **出席+的, 在場+的** — being or existing in a specified place
*“the murderer is present in this room”*
*“present at the wedding”*
3. **現在的 /現在的, 當前 /當前** — Relating to now, for the time being; current.
4. **出席, 在場 /在場** — Located in the immediate vicinity.
*v.* 1. **展覽, 演示, 示範, 展出, 展示** — give an exhibition of to an interested audience
*“She shows her dogs frequently”*
*“We will demo the new software in Washington”*
2. **呈遞, 提交, 提出** — hand over formally
3. **提出, 介紹, 呈現** — introduce
*“This poses an interesting question”*
4. **賞給, 頒發, 贈送** — give, especially as an honor or reward
*“bestow honors and prizes at graduation”*
5. **贈送, 送, 送給, 給** — give as a present; make a gift of
*“What will you give her for her birthday?”*
6. **介紹, 瞭解, 認識** — cause to come to know personally
*“permit me to acquaint you with my son”*
*“introduce the new neighbors to the community”*
*n.* 1. **現在, 當今, 目前** — the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech
*“that is enough for the present”*
*“he lives in the present with no thought of tomorrow”*
2. **禮物** — something presented as a gift
*“his tie was a present from his wife”*
3. **現在 /現在** — The current moment or period of time.
4. a verb tense that expresses actions or states at the time of speaking

*“we can calculate the position of the particles probabilistically”*

<a id="entry-p-005531"></a>
## probability

**發音：** /ˌpɹɒb.əˈbɪl.ɪ.ti/
*n.* 1. **概率, 幾率, 或然性, 可能性** — a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur; a number expressing the ratio of favorable cases to the whole number of cases possible
*“the probability that an unbiased coin will fall with the head up is 0.5”*
2. **幾率, 可能性, 概率, 或然性** — the quality of being probable; a probable event or the most probable event
*“for a while mutiny seemed a probability”*
*“going by past experience there was a high probability that the visitors were lost”*
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **可能性** — The state of being probable.
4. *(countable, uncountable)* **可能性** — The relative likelihood of an event happening.
5. *(countable, uncountable)* **幾率 /幾率, 概率** — A number, between 0 and 1, expressing the precise likelihood of an event happening.

<a id="entry-p-005532"></a>
## probability amplitude

*n.* 1. **概率幅** — A complex number which is the coefficient of a component of a quantum state and whose product with its own complex conjugate gives the probability that the state will collapse to that component (when measured). (Note: the quantum state being thought of as a linear combination of its components.)

<a id="entry-p-005533"></a>
## probability density function

*n.* 1. **機率密度函數 /機率密度函數** — Any function whose integral over a set gives the probability that a random variable has a value in that set.

<a id="entry-p-005534"></a>
## probability theory

*n.* 1. *(uncountable)* **概率論 /概率論** — The mathematical study of probability (the likelihood of occurrence of random events in order to predict the behavior of defined systems).
2. the branch of applied mathematics that deals with probabilities

**發音：** /ˈpɹɒbəbl̩/

*“he foresaw a probable loss”*
2. **可能** — Likely or most likely to be true.
3. **可能** — Likely to happen.
4. apparently destined

*n.* 1. an applicant likely to be chosen

## process

**發音：** /ˈpɹəʊ.sɛs/
*n.* 1. **程序, 過程, 手續** — a particular course of action intended to achieve a result
*“the procedure of obtaining a driver's license”*
*“it was a process of trial and error”*

*v.* 1. **處理** — deal with in a routine way
*“I'll handle that one”*
*“process a loan”*

*“The results of the elections were still being processed when he gave his acceptance speech”*

## pull

**發音：** /pʊl/
*v.* 1. **拖, 拖拉, 拉** — cause to move by pulling
*“draw a wagon”*
*“pull a sled”*
2. **吸引** — direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
*“Her good looks attract the stares of many men”*
*“The ad pulled in many potential customers”*
3. **開動, 行駛** — move into a certain direction
*“the car pulls to the right”*
4. **做錯事, 犯, 犯罪, 做** — perform an act, usually with a negative connotation
*“perpetrate a crime”*
*“pull a bank robbery”*
5. **拉出, 拔, 拿出, 拔出, 取出** — bring, take, or pull out of a container or from under a cover
*“draw a weapon”*
*“pull out a gun”*
6. **拖, 牽, 拉** — steer into a certain direction
*“pull one's horse to a stand”*
*“Pull the car over”*
*n.* 1. *(countable)* **拉** — An act of pulling (applying force toward oneself).
2. **一扭, 扭傷, 扭曲** — a sharp strain on muscles or ligaments
*“the wrench to his knee occurred as he fell”*
*“he was sidelined with a hamstring pull”*
3. the act of pulling; applying force to move something toward or with you
*“the pull up the hill had him breathing harder”*
*“his strenuous pulling strained his back”*
4. the force used in pulling
*“the pull of the moon”*
*“the pull of the current”*
5. special advantage or influence
*“the chairman's nephew has a lot of pull”*
6. a device used for pulling something
*“he grabbed the pull and opened the drawer”*

<a id="entry-p-006552"></a>
## pulse

**發音：** /pʌls/
*n.* 1. **心跳, 心跳節拍, 脈動, 脈搏** — the rhythmic contraction and expansion of the arteries with each beat of the heart
*“he could feel the beat of her heart”*
2. **脈 /脈, 脈搏 /脈搏** — A normally regular beat felt when arteries near the skin (for example, at the neck or wrist) are depressed, caused by the heart pumping blood through them; the qualitative nature of this beat.
3. **脈搏** — the rate at which the heart beats; usually measured to obtain a quick evaluation of a person's health
4. (electronics) a sharp transient wave in the normal electrical state (or a series of such transients)
*“the pulsations seemed to be coming from a star”*

*“The baby's heart was pulsating again after the surgeon massaged it”*
2. produce or modulate (as electromagnetic waves) in the form of short bursts or pulses or cause an apparatus to produce pulses
*“pulse waves”*
*“a transmitter pulsed by an electronic tube”*
3. drive by or as if by pulsation
*“A soft breeze pulsed the air”*

## pyramid

**發音：** /ˈpɪɹ.ə.mɪd/
*v.* 1. **成金字塔狀, 上漲** — enlarge one's holdings on an exchange on a continued rise by using paper profits as margin to buy additional amounts
2. **步步升高, 上漲** — use or deal in (as of stock or commercial transaction) in a pyramid deal
3. arrange or build up as if on the base of a pyramid
4. increase rapidly and progressively step by step on a broad base
*n.* 1. **稜錐, 稜錐體, 角錐, 角錐體, 角錐形** — a polyhedron having a polygonal base and triangular sides with a common vertex
2. **金字塔現象** — (stock market) a series of transactions in which the speculator increases his holdings by using the rising market value of those holdings as margin for further purchases
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **角錐 /角錐** — A solid with triangular lateral faces and a polygonal (often square or rectangular) base.
4. a massive monument with a square base and four triangular sides; begun by Cheops around 2700 BC as royal tombs in ancient Egypt

<a id="entry-p-006882"></a>
## pyramid scheme

*n.* 1. **層壓式推銷 /層壓式推銷, 非法傳銷 /非法傳銷** — An illicit money-making investment scheme in which early investors are paid primarily or wholly from the funds of later investors, and which eventually collapses to the detriment of the most recent participants.
2. a fraudulent scheme in which people are recruited to make payments to the person who recruited them while expecting to receive payments from the persons they recruit; when the number of new recruits fails to sustain the hierarchical payment structure the scheme collapses with most of the participants losing the money they put in

<a id="entry-p-006883"></a>

*prop. n.* 1. **勾股定理, 畢達哥拉斯定理 /畢達哥拉斯定理, 畢氏定理 /畢氏定理** — A mathematical theorem which states that the square of the length of the hypotenuse of a right triangle is equal to the sum of the squares of those of the two other sides.

## python

**發音：** /ˈpaɪθən/
*n.* 1. **蟒, 巨蟒, 蟒蛇, 巨蛇** — Any of the family Pythonidae of nonvenomous constrictor snakes.

3. a soothsaying spirit or a person who is possessed by such a spirit
4. (Greek mythology) dragon killed by Apollo at Delphi

## pyx
